page.title: Virtual clusters
page.hint: vcluster instances of this cluster: StatefulSets and Deployments labelled app=vcluster. Connect adds a virtual cluster to the cluster list through a port forward of this cluster.
page.truncated: Only the first {{max}} StatefulSets and Deployments are listed.
page.unavailable: Some StatefulSets or Deployments cannot be listed. To look in namespaces you can read, choose them in the filter.
page.namespacesCapped: Pods, Services and Secrets are checked in the first {{max}} namespaces only.
page.lifetime: A connected virtual cluster stays in the cluster list only while Sextant forwards a port for it: disconnecting its host cluster, stopping the port forward or quitting Sextant removes it.

connect.title: Connect to vcluster {{name}}?
connect.reads: Sextant reads the Secret {{secret}} in {{namespace}} with your credentials. The kubeconfig in it stays in Sextant's backend.
connect.forwards: A local port is forwarded through {{host}} to the vcluster's API server.
connect.adds: The virtual cluster {{context}} is added to the cluster list, in Sextant's own kubeconfig file vcluster-<PID>.yaml.
connect.lasts: It stays there while the port forward runs: disconnecting {{host}}, stopping the forward or quitting Sextant removes it.

synced.title: Synced objects
synced.hint: Objects the syncer of {{name}} copied from the virtual cluster into this namespace, and the virtual name and namespace each stands for.

source.confirmRemove: Its virtual clusters disappear from the list and Sextant's kubeconfig of them is deleted. Their port forwards keep running until you stop them in Port forwarding.
